newsitem.title: USA: Novellus names Robert Smith as CFO.
newsitem.headline: Novellus names Robert Smith as CFO.

text.p: Novellus Systems Inc on Tuesday appointed Robert Smith, formerly president of Maxwell Graphics, as chief financial officer, effective October 14.
Smith succeeds William Wall, who previously announced he will retire at the end of the year. The company said Wall plans to remain as a consultant until his retirement to ensure a smooth transition.

Novellus said Smith brings to the company experience in mergers, acquisitions and strategic financial planning that will be critical to positioning the company as a major force in the semiconductor manufacturing equipment industry.
